name: Product Specification Sheet Template
search_intent: Food manufacturers, NPD technologists, commercial bakers, and caterers requiring a comprehensive technical product specification document that complies with BRCGS, SALSA, and UK FIC food labelling regulations.

competitors.title: Product Specification Sheet Template | FoodDocs
competitors.strengths: Clean layout, mentions food safety standards.
competitors.weaknesses: Paywalled behind software trial, requires card or business email.

competitors.title: Product Specification Sheet Checklist | SafetyCulture
competitors.weaknesses: App download gate, lacks interactive web-based calculation of QUID and 14 UK allergens.

competitors.title: Free Product Specification Templates | Smartsheet
competitors.weaknesses: Generic manufacturing template, entirely missing food safety, allergens, and shelf-life micro criteria.

competitors.title: How to Create a Food Product Specification | High Speed Training
competitors.weaknesses: Informational blog article only, no interactive builder or printable PDF spec creator.

competitors.title: Product Specification Services | Campden BRI
competitors.weaknesses: High-cost commercial service brochure, no free templates or digital tools.

gap_analysis.what_they_have: Generic spreadsheets or paywalled enterprise software demos.
gap_analysis.what_they_lack: An ungated, interactive browser-based food product specification builder with real-time QUID percentage calculation, 14 UK allergen matrix checkboxes, packaging gas options, and instant PDF technical data sheet generation.
gap_analysis.what_we_offer: Fully responsive Product Specification Tool with multi-tab data entry (general, ingredients, allergens, nutrition, micro criteria), live document preview, and one-click PDF/print export.
